Topics · Hard times

My child died. Did God need another angel?

No full answer is claimed. The Quran never says God needed your child, and it lets you tell God everything.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَـٰرِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِۦ لَوْلَآ أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

Quran · Al-Qasas 28:10

Translation

By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

Original · Ancient Greek

Πίστει Μωϋσῆς γεννηθεὶς ἐκρύβη τρίμηνον ὑπὸ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ, διότι εἶδον ἀστεῖον τὸ παιδίον καὶ οὐκ ἐφοβήθησαν τὸ διάταγμα τοῦ βασιλέως.

Hebrews · 11:23

World English Bible

Start with what the Quran does not say. It does not say God needed your child, or that it was your child's turn. Nothing in the text says that. In another story, of a mother parted from her son, it says her heart became empty. Empty. It names the emptiness, and says her heart was bound fast so that she stayed steady. That story is of a parting, not a death, and is brought here only for what it says about a heart.

A question for you

What have you heard that hurt?

If you sayThat God needed another angel.
ThenThe text does not say it, and this page does not claim it. You may set it aside.
If you sayThat this is a test.
ThenThis app will not tell you what your child's death means. The Quran speaks of trials in this life in general, but it does not say why your child died, and no one may claim to know.
If you sayNothing. I only need to grieve.
ThenThat has its place. The next verse says grief is not forbidden.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَتَوَلَّىٰ عَنْهُمْ وَقَالَ يَـٰٓأَسَفَىٰ عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَٱبْيَضَّتْ عَيْنَاهُ مِنَ ٱلْحُزْنِ فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ٨٤ قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ تَفْتَؤُا۟ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ حَتَّىٰ تَكُونَ حَرَضًا أَوْ تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْهَـٰلِكِينَ٨٥ قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ٨٦﴾

Translation of the meaning

And he turned away from them and said, "Oh, my sorrow over Joseph," and his eyes became white[614] from grief, for he was [of that] a suppressor.[615] They said, "By Allāh, you will not cease remembering Joseph until you become fatally ill or become of those who perish." He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.

Translator's notes

[614] i.e., he lost his sight. [615] He did not express the extent of his grief or his anger at what he suspected his sons had done but was patient, depending only upon Allāh for help.

Quran · Yusuf 12:84-86

Translation

I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

Original · Hebrew

ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃ אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃ בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

the Psalms · 142:1-3

World English Bible

In the Quran there is a father who grieves for his son until his eyes turn white. Those around him tell him to stop. He does not. He says he takes his sorrow to God alone. These verses give a grieving father no reason and no excuse. They give him permission: to tell God what is in you without softening it.

A question for you

What do you need from the people around you?

If you sayFor them to sit with me, without words.
ThenTell them so in your own words if you can. Many do not know that silence is a gift.
If you sayFor them to stop explaining it to me.
ThenThat is a fair request. The explanation is not in the text you are reading.
If you saySome days I do not want to go on.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, so please do not carry this alone. Talk today to someone you trust, a doctor, or a helpline where you live, and if you are in danger now, reach for the nearest person who can help.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:83

Translation

Yahweh restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.

Original · Hebrew

וַֽיהוָ֗ה שָׁ֚ב אֶת־שְׁב֣וּת אִיּ֔וֹב בְּהִֽתְפַּֽלְל֖וֹ בְּעַ֣ד רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַ֧יֹּסֶף יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאִיּ֖וֹב לְמִשְׁנֶֽה׃

Job · 42:10

World English Bible

A short sentence in the verse: harm has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful. Notice that both halves come in one breath. The sufferer says his state without ornament, then names God most merciful, without asking for an explanation. The verse does not say the pain has a beautiful reason. It says complaint and hope can sit in one breath.

A question for you

Which is closest to where you are now?

If you sayOnly: harm has touched me.
ThenStay with that sentence. It is in the book, and a prophet said it.
If you sayI want Him to be merciful, and I cannot see it.
ThenThe wish itself is something the verse says. No more is asked of you tonight.
If you sayI am angry.
ThenAnger is allowed here. Complaint was in the book before your anger was born.

The same in the other books
